content:
Hello everyone,

I have been working on prim-parser, a parser combinator library in the parsec tradition that guarantees termination of parsers by using graded monads. In this blog post I go over the library in detail, including examples, and compare it to similar projects.

The library satisfies two requirements I care about:

  1. Total. Unlike lean4-parser, prim-parser does not use partial internally. Termination is ensured by the Lean typechecker.
  2. Convenient. It offers a parsec-style monadic interface that's already familiar to many users.

Feedback is welcome.

Cheers.
